text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

—A mile race pushing stamina to its 
absolute limit. —A heavy track she 
struggles on. Even so...

Seeking the Pearl showcased world-class 
sharpness. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's it... That explains 
it...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki, you're...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This too... is destiny.

Seeking the Pearl returned to the 
underground passage, completely unbothered 
by being soaked from head to toe.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, pretty much.
There are—two choices. In other words...

Shall we head to the sprint race 'Prix 
Maurice de Gheest' and aim to claim 
Europe's first GⅠ before Taiki Shuttle 
does?

Head to the Prix Jacques Le Marois mile 
race and battle Taiki Shuttle for the 
glory of a first European G1 victory, 
or...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's aptitude for the mile truly was 
incredible. Luck plays a part too, so she 
didn't win every time, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She's a wonderful Umamusume who can 
overcome any bad condition.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And for who I am right now, sprints really 
are better suited for me after all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And not on a madness of a track like 
today's, but on a firm, good track under 
clear skies.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now I understand. Yes, for our next 
race... going to the Prix Maurice de 
Gheest would be better.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It would be better to challenge for my 
first European Gâ title on a turf and 
sprint distance that truly suits me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And I'm sure that can be achieved.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see it... Seeking the Pearl... That name 
represents—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Spoken of for generations alongside 
glory... Yes, as the first horse girl from 
Tracen Academy to conquer a European GⅠ—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This is a promised future, Trainer.

The path is set. I will head to the Prix 
Maurice de Gheest and win before Taiki 
Shuttle does.
This was Seeking the Pearl's—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Bat!!

A booming "WHAT?!" suddenly blasted from 
Seeking the Pearl's mouth.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Are you okay with that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After witnessing that great run from 
Taiki, can you really say this is enough?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I... we are those who show possibilities 
to the world. Those who maximize our true 
selves and overcome insurmountable walls!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can you really say you've achieved it if 
you avoid competing against Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is born with a destiny. 
Fulfilling it is wonderful. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Some people are destined never to be 
fulfilled. Are you telling them to just 
accept that, too?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, is it? Destiny isn't a 
railway you are forced to follow. That's 
right—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Something to surpass! Something you CAN 
surpass! If you can get past it, beyond 
that lies—even more potential!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Proving that is our job, isn't it, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's time to part ways!! Turnaround!! In 
search of a better future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I will be skipping... the Prix Maurice de 
Gheest!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know. —I can feel it. Even while defying 
destiny, there is always a path that 
surpasses even that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Seeking a very good future! It's a quest! 
And I will definitely reach it, no matter 
what!

“—A shocking decision. Withdrawing from 
the Prix Maurice de Gheest.”

With this, Seeking the Pearl's path had 
changed. What would become of her future 
now?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's think about this together. We're 
putting a stop to letting fate push us 
around right here.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I'll take the helm myself. 
The ones deciding... are you and I.
